kebab_example: aliyun gpdb create-supabase-project --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --project-name supabase_demo --zone-id cn-hangzhou-i --account-password 'TestPassword123!' --security-ip-list 0.0.0.0/0 --vpc-id vpc-bp1234567890 --vswitch-id vsw-bp1234567890 --project-spec 2C4G --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateSupabaseProject

parameters.help_en: The region ID. Specifies the region in which to create the project
parameters.help_zh: 地域 ID。用于限定查询或操作所在地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Supabase project.

Naming rules:

The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length.
The name can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_).
The name must start with a letter or an underscore (_)
parameters.help_zh:
Supabase 项目名称。

命名规则：

长度为 1~128 个字符。
只能包含英文字母、数字、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
必须以英文字母或下划线（_）开头
parameters.name: project_name

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. The zone of the vSwitch specified by VSwitchId must be the same as this parameter value
parameters.help_zh: 可用区 ID。VSwitchId 所在可用区需要与该参数一致
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The password of the initial account.

Password rules:

The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Supported special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=
parameters.help_zh:
初始账号密码。

密码规则：

长度为 8~32 个字符。
至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的三类。
支持的特殊字符包括 !@#$%^&*()_+-=
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en: The IP address whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,). If this parameter is not specified, the default value 0.0.0.0/0 is used
parameters.help_zh: IP 白名单。多个 IP 或网段使用英文逗号分隔；不传时默认值为 0.0.0.0/0
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). This parameter is required
parameters.help_zh: 专有网络 VPC ID。该参数必填
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The vSwitch ID. This parameter is required. The zone of the vSwitch must be the same as the value of ZoneId
parameters.help_zh: 交换机 ID。该参数必填，且交换机所在可用区需要与 ZoneId 一致
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The specifications of the Supabase project. The Free billing type uses free-tier specifications. For paid billing types, the specifications must match those available in the console
parameters.help_zh: Supabase 项目规格。Free 计费类型会使用免费规格；付费类型规格需与控制台售卖规格一致
parameters.name: project_spec

parameters.help_en: The storage size, in GB. If this parameter is not specified for non-Free billing types, the default value is 1 GB
parameters.help_zh: 存储空间大小，单位 GB。非 Free 计费类型不传时默认值为 1GB
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The performance level (PL) of the cloud disk. If this parameter is not specified, the default value PL0 is used.

Valid values:

PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.help_zh:
云盘性能等级。不传时默认值为 PL0。

可选值：

PL0
PL1
PL2
PL3
parameters.name: disk_performance_level

parameters.help_en: The idempotency token. Ensures that duplicate requests do not result in duplicate operations
parameters.help_zh: 幂等 Token。用于保证重复请求不会重复执行同一操作
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The billing type. If this parameter is not specified, the default value Free is used.

Valid values:

Free: Free tier.
Postpaid: Pay-as-you-go.
Prepaid: Subscription
parameters.help_zh:
计费类型。不传时默认值为 Free。

可选值：

Free：免费类型。
Postpaid：按量付费。
Prepaid：包年包月
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en: The subscription duration. This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to PrePay. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 1
parameters.help_zh: 购买资源的时长。仅 PayType 为 PrePay 时生效；不传时默认值为 1
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. This parameter takes effect only when PayType is set to PrePay. If this parameter is not specified, the default value Month is used.

Valid values:

Month: month.
Year: year
parameters.help_zh:
购买资源的时长单位。仅 PayType 为 PrePay 时生效；不传时默认值为 Month。

可选值：

Month：月。
Year：年
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable auto start/stop. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is false
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启自动启停。不传时默认值为 false
parameters.name: auto_scale

parameters.help_en:
The DPI engine version. If this parameter is not specified, the default value PG15 is used. PG17 and later versions support the data sandbox (branch) feature.

Valid values:

PG15: PostgreSQL 15.
PG17: PostgreSQL 17, which supports the data sandbox feature
parameters.help_zh:
引擎版本。不传时默认值为 PG15。PG17 及以上版本支持数据沙箱（分支）功能。

可选值：

PG15：PostgreSQL 15。
PG17：PostgreSQL 17，支持数据沙箱功能
parameters.name: engine_version
